images.caption: The Dom Tower in Utrecht, the Netherlands is one of the best known landmarks of this country. This gothic tower is the highest church tower (112,5 metres/368 feet) in the Netherlands and was built between 1321 and 1382 as part of the Cathedral of St. Martin. The resolution of the original photograph is 7768*4150.

images.caption: Excavation for the purpose of uncovering the foundations of pillars of the ruined nave of the cathedral of Saint Martin, Utrecht. The nave was destroyed at 1674 August 1 due to a tornado. The builders had left out vital support for the walls of the nave, as the flying buttresses, to save money.
images.alt: Excavation for the purpose of uncovering the foundations of pillars of the ruined nave of the cathedral of Saint Martin, Utrecht. The nave was destroyed at 1674 August 1 due to a tornado. The builders had left out vital support for the walls of the nave, as the flying buttresses, to save money.
